intent: Sprint from the lower fields up a zigzagging ridge, cross the summit and descend the far side. Expert redesign: ridge fans and downhill rolling cutters.

sections.name: The lower fields
sections.lesson: Build a steady rhythm across the fields. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The lower fields
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The zigzag ascent
sections.lesson: Reverse around the hillside’s shoulders. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The zigzag ascent
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The rocky ridge
sections.lesson: Brake on the broad rocks before the next cut. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The rocky ridge
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The exposed summit
sections.lesson: Gain the top against the wind. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The exposed summit
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The rapid descent
sections.lesson: Follow the terraces down the far side. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The rapid descent
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

difficulty.verification_profile: default movement and charge dash, horizontal 1.5, unassisted
